description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Auton Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Auton Soldier trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
